industry: Hebrew crossword (תשבץ/תשחץ) help: dictionaries, glossaries, solvers
method: Google IL SERP scraping (8 head + long-tail queries) + full-page scrapes of top-ranking competitor templates

competitors.name: מורדו (Mordo)
competitors.description: The dominant Hebrew crossword-definitions dictionary. A Blogspot blog with thousands of per-definition posts, built since ~2012. Ranks #1-2 and often takes 2-3 slots per definition SERP.
competitors.url_structure: /YYYY/MM/blog-post_NNNN.html — one post per definition, often multiple posts per definition variant
competitors.page_template: H1 = definition + variant ('קיבוץ בצפון | קיבוץ בצפון הארץ תשחץ'); branded intro paragraph; answers grouped by letter count then multi-word; bolded answers; inline links to related definition posts; 'ביטויים דומים' block listing query variants (X תשחץ, X מילון, שם של X 5 אותיות); comments used to crowdsource missing answers; on-page search box
strengths: 13+ years of accumulated pages and backlinks; strong brand ('הוסיפו מורדו לכל הגדרה')
Multiple posts per definition variant capture many phrasings of the same query
'ביטויים דומים' footer targets long-tail variants explicitly
Active comment section = free content updates + freshness signals
Cross-linking between related definitions inside answer lists
Facebook page with 11K+ likes drives brand queries
Content marketing pages (tips, brain training, history of crosswords) broaden topical authority
weaknesses: Blogspot platform: dated design, no HTTPS custom domain, poor mobile UX, heavy ads
No structured grouping by category or length beyond flat lists
No interactive pattern solver
Answers unverified; comments show missing answers (e.g. missing kibbutzim)
competitors.notes: Their answer corpus is what solver/retrieve_defs.py scrapes (mordo.jsonl, 31K pairs). They are the benchmark for the per-definition page pattern.

competitors.name: Note (note.co.il)
competitors.description: 'עזרה בפתרון תשחצים ותשבצים - המילון הכי שימושי בישראל'. Dedicated .co.il crossword-answers dictionary; consistently #1-3, frequently two slots per SERP (dual /solution/ and /solutions/ paths).
competitors.url_structure: /solutions/<definition_with_underscores> and /solution/<definition-with-hyphens>/ (two parallel page sets); /abc/<letter> alef-bet index pages
competitors.page_template: H1 = definition; intro paragraph naming the newspapers where the clue appears (ידיעות 7 ימים, מעריב, הארץ, לאישה, ישראל היום — great keyword bait); answers grouped 'פתרון של N אותיות' then 'פתרון של 2 מילים, N אותיות'; user-submission CTA; 'ערכים אחרונים שנוספו' fresh-links module; full alef-bet nav on every page
strengths: Exact-match .co.il domain fully dedicated to the niche
Cleanest information architecture: letter index -> definition pages
Newspaper names in boilerplate capture 'תשחץ ידיעות אחרונות פתרונות'-type queries
Recent-additions module gives every page fresh internal links
Two URL variants per definition double SERP presence
weaknesses: Thin content: no explanations of answers, no per-answer detail
No length-specific pages (loses 'X 5 אותיות' queries to yo-yoo)
Ad-heavy ('קישורים ממומנים' above content)

competitors.name: יויו תשבצים (yo-yoo.co.il/crossword)
competitors.description: Crossword-solutions section of a large games/leisure portal. Ranks top-5 with the most sophisticated URL architecture in the niche.
competitors.url_structure: /crossword/solution/<id> (definition page); /crossword/pages/solution-N.php?id= (per-length subpage: 'X N אותיות'); /crossword/pages/solution-2w.php?id= ('X 2 מילים'); /crossword/list/<letter>; /crossword/category/<id> (topic categories); /crossword/search (interactive pattern solver); /crossword/searchN/ (words by length)
competitors.page_template: H1 = definition (+synonym variants); category chip (גאוגרפיה); answers by length; keyword-rich paragraph; links to every per-length subpage of the same definition; user-submission CTA; alef-bet nav; related-entries block; sitewide footer to tools (פותר תשחצים, פותר וורדל, חרוזים, גימטריה)
strengths: Per-length subpages win the '<clue> N אותיות' long tail nobody else targets
Interactive automatic solver (pattern search א?א) — a tool, not just lists
Category taxonomy + huge internal-link mesh from portal with existing domain authority
Covers adjacent intents: Wordle solver, rhymes, acronyms, gematria — topical breadth
weaknesses: Portal branding (kids games site) dilutes trust for the crossword audience
Dated PHP UX; per-length pages are near-duplicates (thin)
Definition coverage smaller than mordo's

competitors.name: 14across (14across.co.il)
competitors.description: THE community site for serious Israeli solvers: user-created puzzles, and crowd-sourced full solutions to newspaper crosswords — including the Haaretz תשבץ היגיון by יורם הרועה, this repo's exact subject. Owns 'פתרונות תשבץ היגיון <עיתון>' queries.
competitors.url_structure: /answers.php?crossword=<id>&name=<paper+setter> — per-issue solution threads, fresh page every week; also puzzle-play pages
competitors.page_template: Per-newspaper-crossword answer threads dated per issue; users pick a clue and propose/see solutions; app promotion (XWordScan)
strengths: Weekly fresh, date-stamped pages for every major newspaper puzzle = owns all 'פתרונות תשבץ היגיון הארץ/מעריב/ידיעות' queries
Real community with recurring contributors; network effects
Covers cryptics (תשבצי היגיון), which the dictionaries ignore
weaknesses: Solutions are bare answers — no explanations of the wordplay
Old-school PHP site, weak on-page SEO (query-string URLs)
No definition-dictionary (loses the huge 'הגדרה X' long tail)
competitors.notes: Direct competitor for our niche differentiator (Haaretz cryptic). Their weakness — unexplained answers — is exactly what our solver's wordplay explanations can beat.

competitors.name: תשחציישן (arrowword.co.il)
competitors.description: Modern WordPress challenger (est. ~2021) proving the niche is winnable: already ranks page-1 on major definition queries against 10-year incumbents.
competitors.url_structure: /<definition>-תשחץ/ pretty Hebrew slugs; /category/<topic>/ (music, mythology, cities, kibbutzim, moshavim, synonyms...)
competitors.page_template: H1 'עיר באיטליה תשחץ / תשבץ'; breadcrumbs; intro; answers by length with inline links to related definition pages; long unique 'מידע מעניין' section (e.g. 10 Italian cities described) = real content depth; comment box for missing answers; category mesh; prev/next nav; result-count in title tag ('120+ פתרונות אפשריים')
strengths: Proof of concept: a new site broke into these SERPs with WordPress + clean slugs + content depth
Unique prose sections make pages non-thin — likely why Google rewards it
Dense category taxonomy and internal anchor links inside answer lists
Curiosity-gap titles with answer counts improve CTR
weaknesses: Much smaller coverage than mordo/note
Ad placeholders everywhere; generic template
Content sections read as AI/outsourced filler — vulnerable to quality updates
competitors.notes: The best template to study: it's what 'winning as a newcomer' looks like in this niche.

competitors.name: זולו - מנוע התשבצים (zolo.co.il)
competitors.description: 'מנוע התשבצים הגדול' — a professional crossword definitions/answers engine on the Zolo portal, aimed at both solvers and constructors.
competitors.url_structure: Single tool page + huge indexed definition list pages
competitors.page_template: Search engine over definition->answer pairs; massive on-page word lists (אבדה - חפץ שאבד...)
strengths: Large definition->answer database
Serves constructors too (unique audience)
Portal domain authority
weaknesses: Tool-first, few crawlable per-definition pages
Dated UX
No community or content

competitors.name: Snopi crossword dictionary
competitors.description: Pattern-based word finder (מד??ה -> מדבקה, מדגרה) + Wordle helper. Ranks top-10 on 'מילים לתשבץ לפי אותיות' tool queries.
strengths: Owns the pattern-search intent
Simple and fast
weaknesses: Single-page tool, no definition dictionary, no content moat

competitors.name: פשר (pesher.net)
competitors.description: Definition-answers site with Hebrew-slug WordPress URLs (e.g. /סופר-ישראלי-תשחץ-תשבץ/), appearing on page 1 for some definition queries.
strengths: Clean per-definition pages with answers by length
weaknesses: Small coverage, little differentiation

competitors.name: פתרותי (ptoroti.blogspot.com)
competitors.description: Mordo-imitator Blogspot with prose-style answer posts; picks up scraps on some SERPs.
strengths: Prose explanations around answers
weaknesses: Blogspot, small, no brand

competitors.name: התשחץ שלי (xword.co.il) + app
competitors.description: Play-crosswords site + top Google Play app ('התשחץ שלי'). Competes for 'תשחץ אונליין/יומי' play intent, not dictionary intent.
strengths: Daily puzzle habit loop, app-store presence
Owns play-intent SERPs
weaknesses: No definitions dictionary — different intent

competitors.name: Newspaper puzzle sections (haaretz.co.il, israelhayom.co.il, maariv)
competitors.description: Official puzzle pages (תשחץ היומי, תשבץ היגיון PDF). Own brand queries and 'תשחץ היום' plays; also the source material everyone else answers.
strengths: Domain authority, brand demand, daily freshness
weaknesses: Never publish solution explanations — leave that traffic to 14across and us

competitors.name: Generic dictionaries + UGC (milog.co.il, milononline.net, Wikipedia categories, YouTube answer videos, shironet)
competitors.description: Not crossword sites, but absorb SERP slots: Wikipedia categories (קטגוריה:קיבוצים במחוז הצפון) rank on nearly every definition query; YouTube 'פתרונות תשחץ' timeline videos now appear; milog/milononline take 'מה זה X' intents.
competitors.notes: Also observed: spam/parasite SEO (schlossmalberg.de ranking for קיבוץ במחוז הצפון תשחץ) — a sign these SERPs are weakly defended and freshly winnable.

market_observations: The atomic search unit in this niche is the CLUE TEXT, not the answer and not the category: users type '<הגדרה> תשחץ' or '<הגדרה> תשבץ' or '<הגדרה> N אותיות'.
Every winning page follows the same skeleton: H1=definition, newspapers-mention intro, answers grouped by letter count then word count, variant-phrase block, submission CTA, alef-bet/category nav.
Freshness + UGC (comments, submissions) are universal among winners.
Two structural gaps nobody fills well: (1) explained answers (WHY the answer fits — especially cryptics), (2) a modern, fast, ad-light UX.
arrowword.co.il proves a newcomer can reach page 1 in ~2-3 years with clean slugs + per-definition pages + unique prose.

tashbetz.gtmascode.dev currently appears in ZERO competitive SERPs despite being indexed: pages target category×length and per-answer units that users don't search, and the dev-subdomain has no authority.
